conviction_note: Q3 financials are new (only unit sales were pre-released on 2026-10-08) and the company-collected consensus is sourced (Q3 adj. EBIT EUR 1,102m, FY EUR 3,871m just above the EUR 3.6-4.1bn guide midpoint), but there has been no MAR ad-hoc since the 22 July raise, and this issuer pre-releases by ad-hoc when the quarter or the guide moves materially, so a guidance confirmation is the likeliest outcome. abs_move is therefore set between the 2.3% guide-reiterated base and the 7% new-numbers base, at 4.5. The only lean is a mild negative: FY consensus implies a Q4 TNA revenue step-up that PACCAR's Q4 delivery guide does not echo. That lean is a peer inference, so p_up is 47. impact_sum (-0.6) and the scaled number (-0.27) share a sign and are close.

findings.finding: FY2026 consensus (EUR 3,871m adj. EBIT, TNA revenue EUR 21,706m) implies Q4 group adj. EBIT of ~EUR 1,433m and Q4 TNA revenue of ~EUR 6,794m: about +15% q/q, roughly 52-53k units at Q3's revenue per unit, against Q3's 45,629. The nearest US peer, PACCAR, guided Q4 deliveries to only 41-43k against Q3's 40,100 (+2-7%) and cited supply constraints. That makes a narrowing of the TNA unit guide (160-180k; Q4 at Q3's run-rate gives ~162k) toward the lower half the more likely guidance surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 guidance raise came by ad-hoc after the close (the full Q2 release on 2026-08-07 then moved about -2.8% on the estimated history). The May 2026 Q1 print, with a cut North American volume outlook per 4investors, moved about -5.9% on the estimated history. Both dates are cadence estimates.
findings.why_not_priced: The Q4 arithmetic is not published anywhere: the consensus PDF gives Q3 and FY only, and PACCAR's Q4 delivery guide is in a US filing that German previews do not cross to DTNA. If it were priced, the FY consensus collected on 19 Oct would already sit at or below the guide midpoint rather than above it. It may still be priced through buy-side positioning, which is unobservable (no short register anchor).
findings.independence: PACCAR Q3 2026 release, 2026-10-27, Q4 deliveries 41,000-43,000 and supply constraints (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000075362/000119312526432729/pcar-ex99_1.htm, with the delivery guide reported at https://www.mitrade.com/insights/news/live-news/article-0-2200268-20261028). Also FTR August 2026: 2026 build slots sold out and 2027 boards not yet open (https://www.aftermarketnews.com/august-class-8-orders-reach-18200/).

findings.finding: PACCAR's Q3 2026 Truck, Parts and Other pretax income was $858.9m on $7,377.6m of sales: 11.6%, against 8.6% a year earlier and ~10.2% in H1 2026 (9M $2,210.7m on $20,608.9m less Q3). PACCAR attributed the profit growth to 'higher truck segment margins', which corroborates that the North American margin recovery under the current tariff framework is real, and so that the consensus TNA step to 11.8% (from 8.4% in Q2) is reachable.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: TNA margin misses have driven this name's largest reactions (Q3 2025 TNA EBIT -64% y/y; Q1 2026 about -5.9% on the estimated history). PACCAR itself fell -0.6% and -1.3% in the two sessions after its own print, so the peer beat was not rewarded.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is a public peer print nine days old, and DTG was flat to down in the sessions after it. The small residual is that German coverage frames TNA through DTNA's own tariff application, not PACCAR's margins. A peer proxy, and PACCAR is US-built while DTNA builds partly in Mexico, so the transmission is partial.
findings.independence: Daimler Truck's own 2026-08-07 statement that the trajectory 'will accelerate significantly in the third quarter' (https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/53561469). That is the company's own guidance language, not an independent series.

findings.finding: TRATON's 9M 2026 report: adjusted operating return 6.9% (Q3 around 6.8% vs 6.4%), with the business weighed by higher tariff and raw-material costs. International Motors, the other Mexico/US-exposed North American maker, stayed at a 1.7% margin. Revenue slightly missed and the shares fell (-2.0% on 2026-10-28).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No DTG-specific history of reacting to raw-material cost lines. The cross-read is weak.
findings.original_quote: Bereinigte Operative Rendite bei 6,9 %, nach 6,3 % im Vorjahreszeitraum ... Belastet wurde das Geschäft durch höhere Zoll- und Rohmaterialkosten (search-snippet rendering of the EQS-News release; translation: adjusted operating return at 6.9% after 6.3% a year earlier; business burdened by higher tariff and raw-material costs) -- snippet_only, the full release was not opened
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: a public peer release a week old. The only unpriced residual is that raw-material and tariff cost pressure at a German peer may also show up in MBT's 6.3% consensus margin. Peer-to-company transmission is a hypothesis, so the finding is kept small.
findings.independence: Traton share-price reaction: 'Umsatz verfehlt Schätzung knapp, Aktie fällt trotz höherer Marge' (https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/traton-aktie-umsatz-verfehlt-schatzung-knapp-aktie-fallt-trotz-hoherer-marge), the same event, so not independent of the fact.

baseline_tension: The mild negative lean agrees with the tiny negative priced_lean (-0.15) and cuts slightly against the +3% 5-day bounce, which is a sector move rather than a DTG-specific one.
language_note: The Mercedes-Benz Stimmrechtsmitteilung (5 Nov 2026), which shows the pension-trust 5.37% being reattributed to Mercedes-Benz AG, appeared only as a German EQS item. Rejected for this window.

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'size the move on what is new': the Q3 financials are new and only units were pre-released, so abs_move goes from 4.0 to 4.5, which moves expected_move from -0.24 to -0.27. Finding sizes are unchanged.
'A German ad-hoc filed before the print may have pre-released the number': checked, and none was filed since 2026-07-22. That stays the reason abs_move sits below the 7% new-numbers base.
'A beat made of a one-off is sold': confirmed the decision not to file the unsourced retroactive tariff-offset catch-up as a positive.
